candidates.source_name: NJIF-K Legjislacioni — laws, administrative instructions, international standards

Administrative instructions are where filing thresholds and deadlines actually live.

candidates.why_relevant: Publishes four consolidated designation lists that Kosovo reporting entities must screen against: FIU-K national list (XLSX), UN Security Council list (PDF), EU list (PDF), and OFAC list (XLSX). Update cadence is visibly uneven (UN dated Aug 2026, EU Apr 2026, FIU-K and OFAC Jun 2024), which is itself a trackable signal about national list staleness.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a MONEYVAL mutual evaluation report (MER) for Kosovo and for Kosovo's MONEYVAL membership status.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MONEYVAL MER for Kosovo was found and Kosovo does not appear among MONEYVAL's members/jurisdictions subject to its evaluation procedures. Kosovo's AML/CFT compliance is instead assessed through the Council of Europe / EU joint 'Project against Economic Crime in Kosovo' (PECK, and PECK II), whose assessment, monitoring and follow-up reports are hosted on rm.coe.int and apply MONEYVAL-style methodology.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes a MONEYVAL evaluation of Kosovo whose action-plan dates become national deadlines. That mechanism exists, but the publisher and document series are PECK/PECK II (plus the annual EU enlargement report), not MONEYVAL plenary follow-up. Monitoring the MONEYVAL evaluations page alone would produce a permanent false negative for Kosovo.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian and English for a published, citable statement of Kosovo's AML reporting thresholds and filing deadlines (STR/SAR turnaround, cash-transaction reporting threshold, cross-border currency declaration).
negative_findings.result_summary: No page stating concrete thresholds or filing clocks was surfaced. The FIU report-online page does not list report types, thresholds or deadlines; it defers to the legislation section. The values presumably sit inside Law 05/L-096 and the individual udhëzime administrative PDFs, which were not opened in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline logic is the core value of this cell. The deadlines are not on any index page and must be extracted from PDF full text, so collection design must include PDF text extraction, not just link monitoring.

negative_findings.description: Searched (sq/en) for a published Kosovo National Risk Assessment (Vlerësimi Kombëtar i Rrezikut) for money laundering and terrorist financing.
negative_findings.result_summary: The FIU legislation index lists a 'risk assessment reports' category, but no NRA document or dedicated NRA landing page was located in this pass. Search results surfaced only the older PECK assessment material and generic institution-level risk-assessment commentary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The NRA drives the risk-based obligations imposed on banks (sectoral risk ratings, EDD triggers). Its absence from search results may mean it is unpublished, published only as an internal document, or buried in an FIU PDF listing — each implies a different collection strategy.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for the Kosovo FIU produced almost no Kosovo-institution results.
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'Jedinica za finansijsku obaveštajnu Kosovo sprečavanje pranja novca izveštavanje banke uputstvo' returned mostly Serbia's own APML/NBS and Republic-of-Serbia material, plus CBK regulation PDFs served under the ?lang=sr / /srpski/ paths. The correct Serbian acronym for the Kosovo body appears to be FOJ-K (Finansijska obaveštajna jedinica), but no sr-language FIU landing page was directly confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian is an official language in Kosovo and the FIU site advertises a Serbian version, but generic sr queries are heavily polluted by Serbia-proper AML authorities. sr collection must be domain-scoped (site:fiu.rks-gov.net, site:bqk-kos.org, ?lang=sr paths) rather than keyword-driven, or it will silently collect the wrong jurisdiction.

negative_findings.description: The Albanian phrase 'masat kufizuese ndaj Kosovës' is dangerously polysemous.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching for Kosovo financial sanctions returns two unrelated things: (a) Kosovo's own regime for implementing UN/EU financial sanctions against designated persons (Law 08/L-146, Law 03/L-183), and (b) the EU's political restrictive measures imposed ON Kosovo after the 2023 northern-Kosovo tensions. Kallxo coverage of the latter dominated the results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive keyword collector on 'masat kufizuese' + 'Kosovë' will mostly harvest EU-Kosovo political news, not the compliance obligations banks must screen against. Queries need disambiguating anchors such as 'lista e sanksioneve', 'personat e shpallur', 'ngrirje e aseteve', or the law numbers.

negative_findings.description: Direct text of Law 08/L-146 on international financial sanctions was not retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: The law is listed on the FIU legislation index, but neither its gazette page nor its PDF was opened in this pass; sq searching on the law number returned adjacent material only. No conclusion about availability should be drawn — this is unverified, not missing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Law 08/L-146 is the legal hook for national designations and asset-freeze timelines, which is where sanctions deadlines for banks originate. It should be resolved to a gazette ActID in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The FIU's 15+ 'Udhëzime Administrative' (2013-2025, covering beneficial owners, NPOs, legal professionals, online activity, statistics) were seen only as a summarised count on the legislation index. Individual titles, numbers, dates and direct PDF URLs were not captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://fiu.rks-gov.net/legjislacioni/ and its sq/en/sr variants, enumerate every linked PDF, and build a register keyed on instruction number + year (e.g. UA MF (NJIF-K) 01/2021 on beneficial owners; UA 001/2013 on statistics/reports). This is the highest-value next action for the cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Enforcement- and prosecution-side actors in the AML chain were not covered: the State Prosecutor / Prokurori i Shtetit and Kosovo Prosecutorial Council, the Agency for the Management of Seized and Confiscated Assets (Law 03/L-141), the Tax Administration (ATK), Kosovo Customs (cross-border currency declarations), and the Kosovo Police financial-crime directorate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sq/sr pass on these actors for AML case statistics, confiscation reporting and customs cash-declaration thresholds, which carry their own filing deadlines for banks' customers and are frequently cited in PECK/EU assessments.

coverage_gaps.description: No public-consultation channel for AML/CFT rulemaking was located. Kosovo operates a government public-consultation platform (konsultimet.rks-gov.net) that was not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search and register the public-consultation platform, filtering for MFPT/NJIF-K items on 'pastrimit të parave', 'sanksione' and 'pronarë përfitues'. The 2026 draft amendment to Law 05/L-096 is the natural test case, and consultations carry explicit comment deadlines.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry-side sources were not covered: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association) and the big-four / compliance-advisory practices operating locally, which publish practitioner summaries of new FIU obligations and their implementation dates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass on the Kosovo Banking Association site and local advisory alerts; these often surface obligations earlier and in more operational terms than the FIU itself.

coverage_gaps.description: Third-party AML risk benchmarks and country assessments were not covered: Basel AML Index, US State Department INCSR Volume II, FATF high-risk/grey-list statements, and Egmont Group membership status for NJIF-K (the FIU site references the Egmont definition, implying a membership relationship worth confirming).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an en-language pass on these; Egmont membership status in particular affects the FIU's international information-exchange capability and is repeatedly assessed in EU reports.

coverage_gaps.description: The EU 2025 enlargement report reportedly notes that the adopted AML/CFT law was pending Constitutional Court review on procedural grounds — a live constitutional-challenge track that determines whether the new obligations and their deadlines take effect at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the Kosovo Constitutional Court (gjk-ks.org) case docket as a monitored source and resolve the specific case number and status; also reconcile it against the April 2026 draft amendment to Law 05/L-096.

brief: Kosovo's AML/CFT rule-setting is anchored on a single, unusually well-structured publisher: NJIF-K (fiu.rks-gov.net), which is trilingual (sq/en/sr) and carries the full stack — Law 05/L-096, the sanctions law 08/L-146, the beneficial-owners law 08/L-265, 15+ administrative instructions from 2013-2025, four consolidated sanctions lists, annual reports and typologies, plus the goAML filing gateway on the separate fic-ks.org operational domain. The key correction for this cell is that Kosovo is not a MONEYVAL member: its FATF-standard evaluations were delivered through the Council of Europe/EU PECK and PECK II projects (rm.coe.int), with the annual European Commission enlargement report now functioning as the recurring, dated external assessment whose findings drive national action plans. Rulemaking is split — the FIU issues instructions for all reporting entities while the CBK issues the binding regulation for licensed institutions — so deadline attribution requires reading both publishers. The live watch items are the April 2026 government-approved draft amending Law 05/L-096, a reported Constitutional Court challenge to the adopted AML law, and the visibly stale national and OFAC sanctions files (dated June 2024) alongside far fresher UN and EU lists.
